- Owner: CareWell SecOps / Redwood Security (joint)

- Decision on deployment mode (Hosted with BAA vs Dedicated/Private for PHI).

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful and the MAP structure looks good. A few clarifying items from our side before the deep-dive:

1) PHI: We are evaluating PHI scope. If PHI will be in scope we will need either a Dedicated/Private deployment or a Hosted offering that supports a BAA and clear isolation guarantees. Please flag which options you recommend.

2) Retention: Our legal team prefers configurable retention up to 7 years for clinical records; can Redwood support retention windows that long (and longer if required by state law)?

3) Logging / Audit Trails: We need guaranteed immutable audit trails for data access and a log export capability to send copies to our SIEM (Splunk). Minimum log retention on our side is 1 year; what is Redwood's default log retention and export latency?

4) KMS / Encryption: Does Redwood support customer-managed keys (Cloud KMS/HSM) for data at rest? Is there an option to bring your own key (BYOK)?

5) Subprocessors & Data Location: Please provide a current subprocessors list and confirm whether any data or backups will be stored outside the US for this engagement.

We can do a security deep-dive on Tue, Mar 10 at 1:00 PM PT — please send the invite. Also looking for a short packet answering the bullets above before the call so our SecOps can prep.

Appreciate it — Jordan

Jordan Lee

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Attachments: redwood-security-brief.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear list. Short answers below; happy to expand in the deep-dive.

1) PHI: For workloads requiring PHI we typically recommend Dedicated or Private deployments. That said, our Hosted offering can operate under a signed BAA for many use-cases — we can scope which clinical workflows are acceptable on Hosted vs Dedicated.

2) Retention: Retention windows are configurable. Default for request/response logs is 90 days, but we support long-term retention via customer-configurable policies and archive/export to your S3 (or configured object store) for multi-year retention (7+ years). We can include contractual retention SLAs in the MAP.

3) Logging / Audit Trails: We provide detailed audit trails (who/what/when) for admin and API operations. Logs can be exported in near real-time to an S3 bucket or pushed to your SIEM via our secure export connectors. Export latency depends on connector configuration but typical S3 export is < 5 minutes. We can commit to an export SLA in the MAP.

4) KMS / Encryption: Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYOK) using major cloud KMS providers and HSM integrations for Private deployments. Keys can be rotated per your policy; data at rest is encrypted and we support envelope encryption models.

5) Subprocessors & Data Location: I attached a current subprocessors summary (see redwood-security-brief.pdf) — we will confirm US-only storage for this engagement if required and can include that as a MAP dependency.

Next steps I propose:
- Redwood delivers a short security packet (attached) and a controls mapping by 2026-03-09.
- Security deep-dive scheduled for Tue, 2026-03-10 13:00 PT (Marissa to send invite).
- Aim to sign MAP v1 by 2026-03-20; target close date for whole deal 2026-04-30.

Let us know any additional must-haves and we will incorporate into the MAP.

Thanks,

--
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
